  WHY: CI on head f1fcdc59 fails in `tests-release-and-log-analysis` with `assert 3 == 2` (test_heal_intake_routes_through_the_selector_from_its_own_directory), which blocks merge. All four reviewers rated this BLOCKER. Fix: change the count to 3 and keep the strip flags as they are.

  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: last_green_run asks for `status=success&branch=<b>&per_page=1` with no creation-time upper bound. A green run newer than the failure therefore comes back as runs[0], parse_last_green_run rejects it as `newer_than_failure`, and no older baseline is looked up.
  WHY: Reports can wait up to 80 minutes in the intake queue, and recovery-scan re-files happen later still. Reproduction then ends as `unverified/no_baseline` even when a valid older baseline exists. All four reviewers rated this NIT. Fix within the one-GET budget: add `-f created=<{before}`.
- .github/workflows/workflow-failure-heal-intake.yml:100-102 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The intake job keeps `timeout-minutes: 130` even though reproduction adds up to repro_wall + 5.5 minutes of synchronous work: 15.5 minutes at the default and 65.5 minutes at the maximum of 60.
  WHY: A report that waits long in the queue and then reproduces can run past 130 minutes, so the job is cancelled during diagnosis or _open_issue and no heal issue is filed. The reviewer rated this MAJOR.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:431-438 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The reproduction helper runs git fetch without credentials, so the fetch fails for private repositories.
  WHY: On private repositories, reproduction would always end as unverified/helper_failed. The reviewer rated this NIT.
